mapper.insert: INSERT INTO investor_memo (memo_date, market, content) VALUES (#{memoDate}, #{market}, #{content}) ON CONFLICT (memo_date, market) DO UPDATE SET content = EXCLUDED.content, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, memo_date AS memoDate, market, content, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM investor_memo WHERE memo_date = #{memoDate} AND market = #{market}

SELECT id, memo_date AS memoDate, market, content, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM investor_memo WHERE market = #{market} ORDER BY memo_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
